subject.title: feat(xiaomi): expose MiMo V2.5 on pay-as-you-go and default to mimo-v2.5

question: Should fresh Xiaomi pay-as-you-go onboarding now default to `xiaomi/mimo-v2.5`, or should this PR stay catalog-only until owners approve the default flip?
rationale: The catalog addition is directly useful, but changing a provider default affects fresh setup, provider routing expectations, and auth/model selection behavior beyond a mechanical catalog fix.

options.title: Approve V2.5 as default
options.body: Rebase the PR, preserve current-main provider metadata, and land the catalog plus default flip with the existing proof refreshed if needed.

options.title: Catalog-only for now
options.body: Keep the V2.5 pay-as-you-go rows and docs/tests, but leave the existing `mimo-v2-flash` default until a separate owner-approved change flips it.

options.title: Pause for Xiaomi owner
options.body: Hold the PR until the Xiaomi provider owners decide the supported default and token-plan alignment policy.

recommendation.title: Approve V2.5 as default
recommendation.body: Rebase the PR, preserve current-main provider metadata, and land the catalog plus default flip with the existing proof refreshed if needed.

likelyOwner.reason: They introduced the Xiaomi Token Plan provider/default/onboarding surface and are the best available history owner for deciding default alignment across Xiaomi providers.
